spans.s: --of five elements: पृथ्वि, वायु, आकाश, आप, and ज्योति; each has its own function; the body is of the earth, प्राण of मारुत or wind, the आकाश of water, and तेजस् of ज्योत्स्न; by their virility, सन्ग्रामस् and visayas do their respective work. वा. ९७. ५५.
(I)--a sage who married two daughters of दक्ष --भूता and सरूपा. Had sons; eleven Rudras, besides crores of their attendants. भा.
(II)--a son of पौरवी and Vasudeva. भा. IX. २४. ४७.
(IV)--a member of the रोहिणी family. Vi. IV. १५. २२.
(I)--a wife of भूत and a daughter of दक्ष. Her sons were the एकादश Rudras. भा.
(II)--a daughter of क्रोधवशा (क्रोधा- वा। प्।), and a wife of Pulaha. Br.
--a son of दक्ष sa1varn2i. भा. VIII. १३. १८.

--the group of five भूतस्;
1: Br. II. ३७. 6;

. १५; १६५. २३-24.
beings are of four kinds; viviparous, अण्डज (egg-born), udbhijja (sprout- ing as plant) and svedaja (sweat produced);
2: वा. २३. ८२; ३०. १०१ and २२७; ६३. 5; ६५. १२२.
worshipped in ceremonies prior to the construction of tanks, etc.
3: M. ५३. ३१; ५८. २६; १६६. 5-8.
Born of the sacrifice of वरुण clothed with तमस्, रजस् and सत्व।
4: वा. ६५. ३३.
--son of Sumati, and father of Vasu. भा.

--भूत and others.
1: वा. 4. ४९.
elementary creation proceeding from तामसिच् अहङ्कार; see पुरुष.
2: Vi.
--a prince who ruled from किलिकिला after the Maunas ceased to reign. भा.
--a group of १३ gods of the Raivata epoch. भा.
--the residence of different भूतस् and गणस् of Trayambaka; description of. वा. ४०. २०-6; १०१. २०८.
--as different from भूतानुवादि; is also प्रवाती. Br.
--leaders of भूतस् and attendants on Rudra. भा.
--an Asura who took part in the देवा- sura war between Bali and Indra. भा. VIII. १०. २०.
--a son of हिरण्याक्ष. A follower of वृत्र in his battle with Indra. भा.
--the period when the planets, seers, Manus and other gods cease their work and seek their abode in Maharloka. Br. II. २१. १५६-64; २४. ८५; २५. १०६; ३२. ६३; ३५. १६८, १९८ and २०३. [page२-574+ ३३]

(I)--(also भूतपतिस्)--fierce, and abandoned by those who seek मोक्ष; spirits harassing children;
1: भा.

.
sons of भूति and followers of Rudra and निशा- caras; described.
3: वा. ५४. ३७-43; ६९. २४२-56.
(II)--five elements--पृथ्वी, वायु, आप, आकाश and ज्योति। Br. III. ७२. ५४;
--creation; first is महत् सर्ग, second भूत सर्ग, third ऐङ्द्रियक सर्ग; this is प्राकृत सर्ग। वा. 4. ५०; 6. ५८-62.
--(अहङ्कार); of the 6th sarga; the five भूतस्: earth, waters, fire, wind and ether; each is ten times greater than the preceding one. Br.

--three-fold movements; नैमित्तिक, प्राकृतिक, and आत्यन्तिक; नैमित्तिक is ब्रह्मा; in the dissolution of creatures lies the natural destruction of all beings; आत्यन्तिक is due to knowledge, not as a result of action; from these ब्रह्मा again begins the work of creation after he wakes [page२-575+ २८] up from his sleep; during his sleep there is no continuous rain; rivers are with little or no waters; the sun's seven rays scorch the earth and draw away even the little water; every- thing is burnt down; no trees or plants; the heat penetrates the पाताल and the वायु लोकस्; all the worlds are burnt down; everywhere is to be seen one flame of fire; then set in clouds in different hues and in different shapes, pour down rains and appease the fire which enters into waters, result- ing in the condition of एकार्णव out of which emerges ब्रह्मा, the first progenitor and पुरुष; the seven sages see him; then, are gradually born all the kings one by one; simi- larly sages, men, gods and other things. Br.
(I)--a son of युयुधान and father of Yugan- dhara. Br. III. ७१. १०१; वा. ९६. १००.
(IV)--a son of Bhautya; the future Manu.
(V)--a साध्य; destroyer of all Asuras. M. १७१. ४४.
(VI)--gave birth to भूतस्, followers of Rudra. वा. ६९. २४२.
--the king after Dhanadharma. His brother was नन्दियश; the fifth ruler of विदिश. Br. III. ७४. १८२; वा. ९९. ३६८.
--the son of नवकण्ठायन, a शुन्ग ruled in Maghada for २४ years. वा. ९९. ३४५.
--as calf for the यक्षस् and the राक्षसस्, भूतस् and others, to milk आसव in a skull from the earth as cow. भा. IV. १८. २१.
